name: PlexTales
author: flathack
description: Browse and play a Plex audiobook library from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Plex audiobook browser and player controls

schema.label: Recently added books
schema.description: Number of recently added books shown in the panel.

schema.label: Library items per view
schema.description: Maximum authors, books, collections, or chapters loaded in one view.

schema.label: Demo mode
schema.description: Show fictional audiobooks and never contact Plex or start mpv.

schema.label: Volume control
schema.description: Choose whether the player slider changes the Omarchy system output or PlexTales local mpv volume.

schema.label: Mini player
schema.description: Open a compact playback popup. The full library remains available from the mini player.
